title: Canonical tensor comparison unit uniqueness
statement: Any two ordinary unit isomorphisms satisfying the canonical normalization equation are equal.

source.place: Tag 07A4, label lemma-pullback-tensor-product, lines 3683-3724; and Tag 0G7E, label lemma-pullback-K-flat, lines 3507-3515

proof.text: Specialize both normalization equations at the source unit. Their right sides agree. Cancel the isomorphism k.mu(unit, unit) on the left and the target right unitor on the right, obtaining identity_A tensor j.hom = identity_A tensor j'.hom, where A = L(unit).

Precompose with j.inv tensor identity_A and postcompose with j.hom tensor identity_unit. Tensor functoriality and j.inv followed by j.hom = identity_unit simplify the resulting equality to identity_unit tensor j.hom = identity_unit tensor j'.hom.
Apply Mathlib MonoidalCategory.tensor_left_iff, the injectivity of tensoring morphisms by the unit, and then Iso.ext to conclude j = j'.

proof_origin.place: Tag 03EL, lemma-tensor-product-pullback: formal uniqueness of the normalized unit via cancellation and the monoidal left unitor (P3).
